title: Autonomous computational validation of quinoxaline ligand 1 geometry
category: molecular geometry optimization and vibrational validation
difficulty_reasons: The endpoint is fixed but the Agent must independently formulate and prioritize a protocol and any conformer alternatives.
The Agent must justify candidate/protocol coverage, validate a stationary point, map the crystal and optimized structures, and report quantitative geometry agreement.

paper.title: Structural and antimicrobial studies on a tricarbonyl rhenium(i) complex with the 6,7-dimethyl-2-(pyridin-2-yl)quinoxaline ligand

data.description: Supplied immutable CCDC 2433822 CIF and compound-1 metadata, including identity, charge and multiplicity; CCDC retrieval is not scored.

required_deliverables.description: Structured independent investigation, validation, mapped bond comparison and conclusion.
